The '''Naboo Puppet Theater''' was a theatrical venue that hosted puppetry performances in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A small, rectangular building with a terraced garden on the roof, the Puppet Theater stood on the same [[Theed Coliseum Plaza|plaza]] as the imposing [[Theed Coliseum]], and was accessed through a [[Color/Legends|red]] and yellow striped marquee.<ref name="ELAC" />
